summary: The recorded base reproduced the original R + ep_size*S arithmetic. The exact candidate correctly scales replicated TP1 shared output only for skips that defer to a later cross-rank SUM, while retaining full S for A2A/FP4 absorbed skips with no later SUM. Focused, related, and independent adversarial tests passed.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-ccc3278da812/venv/bin/python -c <base gfx950 arithmetic reproduction tied to inspected DeepseekV2MoE.forward_normal ordering>
tests.what_was_measured: At base commit 358c163, EP=8 produced the bug formula R + 8*S rather than R + S; maximum absolute error was 15.595807194709778.
At exact candidate commit 6c8bf4d, six focused tests passed, including deferred-SUM scaling and A2A no-later-SUM behavior.
99 related tests and 140 subtests passed at the exact candidate commit.
Independent random-data checks had zero maximum absolute error for deferred SUM, absorbed A2A/FP4 skip, immediate all-reduce, nonreplicated, and single-rank boundaries.

gpu_execution.evidence: Base reproduction and independent candidate arithmetic ran on one AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015.

remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned, so no actual eight-rank RCCL reduce-scatterv or A2A transport was executed.
DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat and GLM-5.2 weights were unavailable, so full-model serving and semantic accuracy were not tested.
The candidate changes only Python source; no native rebuild was applicable.
